segments.name: Telehealth
segments.description: Provides virtual medical care, prescription medications and pharmacy services to patients through consumer telehealth brands, largely on recurring subscriptions.
segments.evidence: As a result, the Company's portfolio of brands within continuing operations are now managed as a 1 single operating segment on a consolidated basis.

revenueModel.text: Patients pay subscription fees and cash or insurance reimbursement for virtual medical consultations, prescription medications and pharmacy fulfillment.
revenueModel.evidence: Approximately 95% of our total revenue is derived from recurring subscriptions.

changes.text: In 2025 the Company sold its majority ownership interest in WorkSimpli, which is classified as discontinued operations.
changes.evidence: On November 4, 2025, we sold our majority ownership interest in WorkSimpli to Lion Buyer, LLC.
